En todo el nivel principal, las terrazas y patios están cuidadosamente integrados con jardines y vegetación, creando una sensación de armonía con el paisaje. La residencia también cuenta con estudio, lavandería y múltiples espacios de convivencia. Una residencia independiente dentro de la propiedad En un nivel inferior se encuentra una casita completamente equipada, ideal para huéspedes, familiares o personal. Incluye sala/dormitorio, comedor, cocina con barra de desayuno, dos baños, sauna, lavandería, bodega y un dormitorio independiente que puede utilizarse como gimnasio o sala de ejercicios. En el nivel superior, una espectacular terraza en la azotea ofrece una chimenea y algunas de las mejores vistas de la propiedad hacia el Lago de Chapala y las montañas. Un elevador conecta los diferentes niveles para brindar comodidad y accesibilidad. Agua proveniente de acuífero y pozo. Tres depósitos de 2,500 litros ubicados bajo el garaje. Sistema hidroneumático. Sistema de agua caliente solar para la piscina. Electricidad de 220 V. Fosa séptica. Sistema de riego Rain Bird de 24 canales. Aspiración centralizada de nivel comercial en toda la residencia. Sistema de audio VSSL y Marantz. Sistema de cine y entretenimiento. Servidor de música. La cocina y las áreas de servicio cuentan con equipamiento excepcional, incluyendo dos lavavajillas, tres hornos, dos trituradores de basura, microondas, dos lavadoras y dos secadoras. Para disfrutar al máximo del estilo de vida al aire libre, la cocina exterior está equipada con Green Egg, horno para pizza Fontana y parrilla de gas Lynx. Espacio, privacidad y potencial de expansión El garaje adjunto tiene capacidad para tres vehículos, además de espacio para tres autos adicionales en la entrada. La propiedad está rodeada por un muro de piedra y cuenta con pasarelas, patios y jardineras que complementan el paisaje. Existen además áreas abiertas a lo largo del perímetro y en las zonas bajas, ideales para desarrollar jardines adicionales o crear espacios exteriores personalizados. Adicionalmente, existe la posibilidad de adquirir junto con la residencia un terreno contiguo de 1,114 m², con un valor de $11,000,000 MXN. Este terreno ofrece vistas espectaculares y representa una extraordinaria oportunidad para ampliar los jardines, crear espacios recreativos o desarrollar una segunda residencia, sujeto a las autorizaciones correspondientes. Una propiedad para compradores que buscan algo verdaderamente excepcional Villa Paradiso no es simplemente una casa; es una residencia concebida para quienes valoran la arquitectura, la privacidad, la calidad constructiva, la tecnología y un estilo de vida extraordinario frente al Lago de Chapala. Una propiedad de carácter único, ideal para un comprador sofisticado que busca una residencia exclusiva en una de las zonas más privilegiadas de la Ribera de Chapala. _______________ Nestled in the Sierra mountains overlooking Lake Chapala, Villa Paradiso is an exceptional private estate where architecture, privacy, sophisticated design and breathtaking natural surroundings come together. Located within an exclusive gated community with 24/7 security, the residence was elegantly designed and built by Gene Fortune and Mauricio Vázquez Higuera, with remarkable attention to craftsmanship, materials and architectural detail. The centerpiece of the home is a spectacular double-height living room featuring five handcrafted brick domes and expansive views of Lake Chapala and the surrounding mountains. Four beautifully sculpted fireplaces, generous covered terraces and a solar-heated infinity pool create an extraordinary setting for both private enjoyment and elegant entertaining. The impressive kitchen is fitted with top-of-the-line Sub-Zero/Wolf appliances and flows seamlessly into the dining and breakfast areas. The primary suite offers generous proportions, privacy and spectacular views. A charming library connects to two additional bedrooms, each with its own full bathroom and walk-in closet. Throughout the main level, inviting terraces and courtyards blend beautifully with the surrounding gardens and natural landscape. The main level also includes a private study, laundry room and additional entertaining spaces. A Separate Guest Residence On the level below, a fully equipped guest casita provides exceptional privacy for family, guests or staff. It includes a living/bedroom area, dining room, kitchen with breakfast bar, two bathrooms, sauna, laundry room, storage and a separate bedroom/exercise room. Above the main level, a spectacular rooftop terrace with its own fireplace offers breathtaking panoramic views of the lake and mountains. An elevator provides convenient access between the different levels of the residence. Exceptional Infrastructure & Technology Villa Paradiso has been designed with comfort, efficiency and self-sufficiency in mind: State-of-the-art solar power and battery backup system. Water supplied by an aquifer and private well. Three 2,500-liter water storage tanks located beneath the garage. Pressurized water system. Solar-heated pool water system. 220V electrical service. Septic system. 24-zone Rain Bird irrigation system. Commercial-grade central vacuum system throughout the residence. VSSL and Marantz audio systems. Home theater and entertainment equipment. Music server. The home is exceptionally equipped, including two dishwashers, three ovens, two garbage disposals, microwave, two washing machines and two dryers. The outdoor kitchen features a large Green Egg smoker, Fontana pizza oven and Lynx gas grill, perfect for entertaining and enjoying the exceptional climate and surroundings. Privacy, Space & Expansion Potential The attached garage accommodates three vehicles, with additional parking for three more cars in the gated driveway. A stone wall surrounds the property, complemented by landscaped pathways, terraces, courtyards and mature plantings. Additional open areas along the perimeter and lower slopes offer opportunities for expanded gardens or customized outdoor spaces. An additional 1,114 m² parcel is also available for purchase together with the residence, valued at $11,000,000 MXN. With spectacular lake and mountain views, the additional land offers an exceptional opportunity to expand the gardens, create additional amenities or potentially develop a second residence, subject to applicable approvals. A Rare Offering on Lake Chapala Villa Paradiso is far more than a luxury home. It is a private architectural estate created for a discerning buyer who appreciates exceptional design, craftsmanship, privacy, technology and an extraordinary connection to nature. A truly distinctive residence for those seeking one of the most exclusive lifestyles on the shores of Lake Chapala.
